mentions.name: Volunteer Scheduling PWA
mentions.description: A progressive web app that helps non-profits offload the admin work of volunteer scheduling, which is otherwise mostly handled through WhatsApp and Messenger.
mentions.problem: Volunteer scheduling admin is mostly managed ad hoc through WhatsApp, Messenger, and similar chat apps.
mentions.source_excerpt: Just today I finished off building a little PWA to help a couple of non-profits offload the admin of volunteer scheduling (mostly done through whatsapp, messenger, etc).

evidence.value: Just today I finished off building a little PWA to help a couple of non-profits offload the admin of volunteer scheduling (mostly done through whatsapp, messenger, etc).
